subject.title: Fix Telegram durable partial final handling

question: Should this PR remain blocked until redacted live Telegram or restart-replay proof is attached, or should maintainers explicitly accept unit-only evidence for this transport-facing edge case?
rationale: The code path is source-plausible, but scoped Telegram policy and the external-PR proof gate require real behavior proof unless a maintainer intentionally overrides that standard.

options.title: Require Real Telegram Proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until a redacted Telegram Desktop, bot-to-bot, runtime-log, or restart/replay artifact shows both the partial-visible and no-send durable failure outcomes.

options.title: Accept Unit-Only Evidence
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept the remaining transport uncertainty and merge based on source review, regression tests, and green CI.

options.title: Coordinate Behind Broader Delivery Work
options.body: Pause final review until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96095 or the canonical durable-delivery issue settles the overlapping completion semantics.

recommendation.title: Require Real Telegram Proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked until a redacted Telegram Desktop, bot-to-bot, runtime-log, or restart/replay artifact shows both the partial-visible and no-send durable failure outcomes.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main routing signal is recent blame on the Telegram dispatch and shared durable delivery paths.
